messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert: runtime-node-7 (us-west-2) reporting OOMs in paged-attention allocator. 12% error rate, container restarts detected. Auto-escalating to on-call. <https://ops.redwood.ai/alerts/1736504321|view alert>

alice: seeing spike in memory usage on node-7, KV cache keep climbing. Pods repeatedly crash with CUDA OOM.

bob: any customer impact flagged?

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident triggered (SEV2) - Pager: @alice oncall. Customers with heavy streaming requests may see 502/timeout.

cameron: attaching recent logs snippet, looks like allocator fragmentation + slow kv growth after long prefix-heavy requests:

```
2025-06-14T02:32:10Z runtime: alloc failed: OOM after 2.3s
stack: runtime/alloc.go:133
kv_cache: resident_pages=124M free_bitmap=2M frag_rate=0.36
attn_paged: page_faults=42 seq_len=1024
CUDA error: out of memory (lhs=0x7f..)
```

alice: thanks. I reproduced locally with a small repro, fragmentation ramps after ~45m of sustained chat sessions.

devon: mitigation checklist: 1) drain node-7 from routing 2) bump evict ratio on kv cache 3) temporarily disable prefix caching on high-req routes 4) redeploy runtime with allocator flag `--paged-compact-interval=30s`

lisa: I'll drain node-7 now and cordon it. Doing kubectl drain with grace 60s.

alice: note for customer ops — affected sessions come from model: gpt-open-vert-1 large context, mostly streaming LLM apps (autocomplete, live chat). We should notify top 5 tenants.

bob: can we do a hotfix that changes eviction without full redeploy? a dynamic config change?

cameron: yes, there's a dynamic knob: KV_EVICT_RATIO. Current 0.12, raise to 0.25 for now. Setting via config API: POST /admin/configs/kv -> {"KV_EVICT_RATIO": "0.25"}

devon: pushed the config change to runtime cluster-1, logs show eviction events increasing, KV resident dropping ~18% in 2m.

alice: good. Lisa how's drain?

lisa: drain complete, pods evicted, traffic rerouted to node-3/4. Watching for CPU/latency impact.

bob: any regressed latency on tail?

cameron: tail p90 for streaming tokens increased 50ms on node-3 but within SLO. Token throughput ok.

alice: customers notified in progress. I'll DM top tenants and set status page draft.

devon: still seeing one container crash with CUDA OOM on node-5 replica - memory leak persists. I'm starting a debug build with extra allocator logging on canary.

bob: can we apply a temporary hard limit on per-request kv pages? e.g., `--kv-max-pages=4096`?

cameron: yes, that prevents runaway sequences. Patch applied to canary runtime, holding at 4k pages. No crashes in 10m.

alice: good sign. Let's keep canary for 30m, then roll to remaining nodes if stable.

lisa: I'll keep node-7 cordoned until we confirm full cleanup / reboot.

alice: postmortem action items (brief): 1) add automatic compact trigger when frag_rate > 0.3 2) expose safe KV_EVICT_RATIO adjustments to oncall 3) limit per-request kv pages by default 4) longer-term: allocator refactor + unit tests for fragmentation patterns.

devon: creating a follow-up ticket and linking logs/traces. TAG: eng-runtime, eng-oncall, sres.

incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated, next update in 30m. <https://ops.redwood.ai/incidents/1736504321|incident link>

alice: thanks team. continuing watch. :eyes:
